Here is the complete, in-order sequence for `addOwner` (POST `/api/owners`, `OwnerRestControllerV1.java:205-257`). I've marked each step as a **validation** (can reject/short-circuit the request) or a **side-effect** (mutates state on the owner, the datastore, or the outside world).

### Pre-entry
0. **[validation]** `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` — caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role or the method never runs (line 205).

### Body of `addOwner`
1. **[side-effect / read]** Read the `Idempotency-Key` request header, trimmed; blank → `null` (`idempotencyKey()`, line 208).
2. **[validation / short-circuit]** `replayIfDuplicateKey` — if a key is present and already recorded, look up the previously created owner and return it with **200 OK**, skipping all creation logic below (lines 209-212, 275-284).
3. **[side-effect]** `addressResolver.resolve(ownerFieldsDto)` — mutates the incoming DTO to populate/resolve address fields (line 213).
4. **[validation]** `ownerFieldsValidator.findMissingOrBlankFields` — if any required field is missing/blank, throw `MissingOwnerFieldsException` (lines 214-217).
5. **[side-effect]** Map DTO → `Owner` entity via `ownerMapper.toOwner` (line 219).
6. **[side-effect / read]** Load existing owners with the same last name (case-insensitive), filtered to **active** (non-soft-deleted) owners via `activeOwners` (lines 220-221, 363-365).
7. **[side-effect]** `owner.setNamesakeCount(...)` — compute and store namesake count against those same-last-name owners (line 222).
8. **[side-effect]** `assignHousehold` — set `householdId` (derived from last name + postcode), compute existing household members, set `householdSize` = members + 1; returns the existing members (lines 223, 295-300).
9. **[side-effect]** `owner.setTelephone(telephoneNormalizer.normalize(...))` — normalize telephone (line 224).
10. **[side-effect]** `owner.setEmail(emailNormalizer.normalize(...))` — normalize email (line 225).
11. **[validation]** `disposableEmailDomainValidator.validate(email)` — reject disposable email domains (line 226).
12. **[validation]** `postcodeValidator.validate(postcode, city)` — reject invalid postcode/city combination (line 227).
13. **[validation]** `rejectIfDuplicateIdentity(owner)` — load active owners with the same (normalized) telephone; if the full identity key matches an existing owner, throw `DuplicateIdentityException` (lines 228, 350-356).
14. **[side-effect + conditional validation]** `applyHouseholdRule` (lines 229, 328-341):
    - If **no** existing household members: run `flagPossibleDuplicate` (sets `possibleDuplicate` / `possibleDuplicateOf`).
    - If there **are** members: set `membershipLevelCap` to the household ceiling; then if `sharesHousehold == true`, clear the possible-duplicate flags; otherwise run `flagPossibleDuplicate`.
15. **[validation]** `registrationDateValidator.validate(registrationDate)` — validate the supplied registration date (line 230).
16. **[side-effect]** If registration date is null, default it to `LocalDate.now()` (lines 231-233).
17. **[side-effect]** `owner.setRegistrationDate(BusinessDayResolver.toBusinessDay(...))` — snap the registration date to a business day (line 234).
18. **[side-effect / read]** Count owners already registered on that (adjusted) registration date (line 236).
19. **[validation]** If `ownersRegisteredToday >= MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY`, throw `DailyOwnerLimitException` (lines 237-239).
20. **[side-effect]** `owner.setBulkSignupWarning(...)` — flag bulk-signup based on the daily count (line 240).
21. **[side-effect / read]** Count owners in the owner's city (line 241).
22. **[validation]** If `cityOwnerCount >= MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY`, throw `CityOwnerLimitException` (lines 242-244).
23. **[side-effect]** `owner.setCapacityWarning(...)` — flag approaching-capacity based on the city count (line 245).
24. **[side-effect / read]** `assignMemberId` — derive a base member id (region/registration date/telephone/last name), read existing ids with that prefix, deduplicate, and set `memberId` (lines 246, 308-318).
25. **[side-effect / persist]** `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` — persist the owner (line 247).
26. **[side-effect]** If an idempotency key was present, `idempotencyStore.record(key, owner.getId())` (lines 248-250).
27. **[side-effect]** `ownerAuditLogger.ownerCreated(owner)` — write an audit-log entry (line 251).
28. **[side-effect / external]** `welcomeNotifier.welcome(owner)` — send the welcome notification (line 252).
29. **[side-effect]** Map the saved owner → `OwnerDto` and set the `Location` header to `/api/owners/{id}` (lines 253-255).
30. Return **201 CREATED** with the DTO and headers (line 256).

### Notes
- The whole method is **not** annotated `@Transactional` (unlike `deleteOwner`), so the persist, idempotency record, audit log, and welcome notification are not wrapped in a single transaction.
- The duplicate/identity checks (steps 6, 13) deliberately ignore soft-deleted owners via `activeOwners`.

I did not open the individual validator/normalizer/service classes; the ordering above is exactly as the controller invokes them. If you want the internal rule details of any specific step (e.g. what `postcodeValidator` or `identityDuplicateValidator` actually reject), say which and I'll read that class.
